items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I guess the Newport Jazz Festival when they had Count Basie and Cy Oliver at the Roseland Ballroom

ctx.x: He was playing in the West End, I believe.

Well, a couple of years ago when they had the New Year's -- I guess the Newport Jazz Festival when they had Count Basie and Cy Oliver at the Roseland Ballroom and Arnett (Cobbs) showed up and played out of this world.
